means: A re-run whose result equals the previous result does not invalidate its dependents; they are not re-run. Prior art in build systems and incremental compilers.
Per-trigger rule for ticks missed while a scheduler was down or busy: fire once now, skip to the next tick, or fire all. Same shape as the catch-up policy in time.md.

name: early cutoff on replay and knockout
claim: When late events or a failed trace guard force re-evaluation, a re-run whose output hash is unchanged stops propagation, so only runs with changed outputs void or re-run their dependents (extends vsbder, gdhqxh, gsioti; docs/platform/survey-A6-A7.md).
